column1: # MANT-0453 (9 Oct 2026): HStA Dresden 10026 Loc. 694/08 URL file 0453 (film card 0454), ff.359v-360; letter No. 88, Berlin 29 Oct 1712

# frame (worker's look at 0.6x native on both pages' upper parts). Two blind Sonnet passes (passA_0453.tsv crop order, passB_0453.tsv
# reversed) agree on every group and code (10 groups, 22 tokens) + worker reconciliation on native zooms (one unit). Ordinary numeral
# '3.' (paragraph) and '4 semaines' are not codes. No interlinear letters on any code (both passes + worker): gate (a) n/a.
# Low: r01 tok4 51 (both passes low; zoom reads 51, alt 57/31; 51 and 57 both s); r02 198 (A low, B medium; alt 197/178); r04 tok5 14
